tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and concave response point to the archived sink-dependent siphon family. The added low-gradient observation breaks the near-constant-gradient ambiguity. Fit the target-specific sink strength and signed square-root branch numerically, then test on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired gradient-varying row, together with the five pilot rows, permits numerical fitting of the three-parameter signed-branch model.
The new gradient contrast provides target-specific information about rho, so fixing it to the archived range is unnecessary.
Deferred to fresh confirmation: the archived signed square-root branch is a direct candidate for the observed concave response.

considered_alternatives.option: Extra fine trajectory batch or nuisance auxiliary
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations support a static siphon candidate; neither a coupled trajectory nor a nuisance measurement is needed to identify its parameters.
